title: Wildfly: unauthenticated network-adjacent attacker can leverage discovery to capture cluster administrative…
description: A critical security vulnerability in Wildfly allows an unauthenticated network-adjacent attacker to capture cluster administrative credentials during the initial cluster connection handshake. This flaw affects Wildfly versions prior to 42.0.0-r1 and has a high CVSS score of 9.1. The vulnerability is fixed in version 42.0.0-r1.
